title: Remove the incorrect consumer connection command from provider details
prompt:
Change only src/app/bazaar/[provider]/page.tsx among production files. Evidence: src/app/bazaar/[provider]/page.tsx:124-134 presents a Connect via Bazaar command posting a provider slug to /api/bazaar/connect. That endpoint is explicitly Stripe Connect onboarding in src/app/api/bazaar/connect/route.ts:6-8 and requires a provider at lines 11-16. It does not connect a consumer to a listed tool. An in-memory render confirmed the misleading command is displayed on provider detail pages.

Replace this one integration section with honest guidance to inspect the live marketplace and follow the existing developer guide, linking to /marketplace and /get-started. Explain that a tool must be listed in the live catalog before using it through Bazaar; these static provider slugs alone do not establish availability. Remove the erroneous POST example without replacing it with an assumed callable tool. Preserve the installation section, tool list, metadata, and existing Coming Soon CTA.

Add exactly one new test file, tests/provider-detail-connection-guidance.test.ts. Render the actual async page with a fixture provider and mocked navigation, then inspect the integration section. Assert both destinations are present, no onboarding command remains, and provider-specific installation details still render. Also preserve the unknown-provider notFound behavior. Run node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/provider-detail-connection-guidance.test.ts. All checks must be local with no endpoint invocation. No credentials, deploys, sends, payments, migrations, workflow, package.json, or auth changes. work on the assigned branch you are on.
